name: W ~Chinurareta Hanayome~
source:
Wedding ceremony is a happy event and no one thought it would be the start of a big tragedy. Everything begins with a minor injury incident to the bride and then one by one people close to Junya are attacked and killed. The dark past strikes back and Junya with Natsumi need to act and find out the truth behind the incidents.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
婚禮本應是喜事，沒人想到它會成為一場巨大悲劇的開端。一切始於新娘受了點輕傷，隨後與純也親近的人一個接一個遭到襲擊並被殺害。黑暗的過去捲土重來，純也和夏美必須採取行動，查明這些事件背後的真相。

［來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
